resolved_findings.resolution: New empty TemporaryDirectory is initialized as a bare repository, bundle verify must pass there, fetch runs with transfer.fsckObjects=true, and FETCH_HEAD must equal the source HEAD. Scratch repository is automatically removed. This proves the bound bundle can supply current HEAD without prior repository commits under the ordinary process environment.
